title: AI/ML Engineer Intern
description: We are looking for an ambitious AI/ML Engineer Intern to build, fine-tune, and evaluate machine learning models. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Python, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, Machine Learning fundamentals, and data manipulation libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. You will collaborate on natural language processing pipelines, integrate models with REST APIs, and apply Git for version control. Exposure to FastAPI and Docker is a strong plus.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description: Seeking a Full-Stack Developer to build responsive user interfaces and robust web APIs. Must be proficient in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern backend frameworks like Node.js or Python FastAPI. Experience with relational databases and Docker is preferred.
